final_answer_full:
The average area of the bridges in the image, calculated using the provided Ground Sample Distance (GSD) of 0.086 meters per pixel, is **56.05 square meters**. This value was derived by processing the detected bridge bounding boxes and applying the GSD to convert pixel dimensions to real-world areas. 

**Key steps:**
1. **Detection**: Bridges were identified using `geo_perception__strip_rcnn_detect`, yielding bounding box dimensions in pixels.
2. **Conversion**: Each bridge's area (in square meters) was calculated as:  
   $$
   \text{Area} = (\text{width\_pixels} \times \text{GSD}) \times (\text{height\_pixels} \times \text{GSD}) = \text{width\_pixels} \times \text{height\_pixels} \times (0.086)^2
   $$
3. **Averaging**: The mean area across all detected bridges was computed using `geo_statistics__mean_of_means`.

This result reflects the average bridge area based on the detected objects and the provided spatial resolution.
